name: [SKIBID TOILET] Find the Orbs! ✨
desc:
Welcome to Find the Orbs! ✨

GOALS:
20 Likes = New Area ✅
7.5K Visits = New Area ❌

In this game you search the map and travel across various areas and realms in order to collect all the Orbs!

While most orbs are relatively simple to find, some require much more patience and skill in order to find. This game is inspired by many "Find The" games especially find the markers!

Thank you to MrMarkerMaker for motivating me to create this awesome game!
